title: Wellesley Taiwanese Cultural Organization
content_html:
The Wellesley Taiwanese Cultural Organization (TCO) is a student organization at Wellesley College dedicated to celebrating Taiwanese culture and fostering community among students with ties to Taiwan. The organization is formally recognized through the college’s official WEngage student engagement platform, where it holds regular weekly meetings and hosts a range of cultural and social events throughout the academic year. Its founding year is not documented in available first-party sources.

TCO operates out of Acorns, a campus cultural house for students of Asian and Latinx descent, and holds weekly Sunday evening meetings as well as recurring signature events such as first-year welcome gatherings, a Big Little Brunch, and an annual fall party called “+866.” The group is part of Wellesley’s Pan Asian Council and is recognized as one of the college’s most active Asian cultural organizations. Membership is open to all students interested in Taiwanese culture, and the organization describes itself as welcoming to those from both Taiwanese and non-Taiwanese backgrounds.

TCO engages with cultural, social, and political dimensions of Taiwanese identity on campus and has maintained a consistent presence across Facebook and Instagram. The organization maintains contact at taiwaneseculturalorg@wellesley.edu. No dedicated standalone website apart from the WEngage directory listing was identified in first-party sources.
